focus: Map adjacent uses and default-on integration requirements, costs, and risks

label: The scorer's Jev keep is a shadow result; it does not promote the live deterministic merge and its contract has no named reader.
The existing default-off flag handles same-body title-aware matching and cannot implement the measured cross-body semantic judgment.
A hosted decision stage should precede the synchronous deterministic reduction and retain bounded work per run.
Using the three-call protocol costs about 3P+1 calls for P eligible pairs, with serial 90-second timeouts and no measured dollar rate.
The cross-loop scorer pools research and review counts, so review-specific lift and risk remain unproven.
RRF fusion and context compaction have possible semantic-dedup use cases, but each needs a task-specific gold set.
Default-on behavior requires privacy and auth gates, per-pair logs and versioning, named ownership, and deterministic no-loss fallback.

direction: Flip SPECKIT_FANOUT_NEAR_DUP_DEDUP as the implementation of default-on Jev
